warnings.precise_source_claim: repeated endpoint makes a count degenerate
warnings.warning: Source writes num_0=(p_max-p_max)/l_0 and also repeats p_max in the l_0 definition. For finite nonzero l_0 the displayed numerator is zero, which does not implement the intended positive grid count.
warnings.safe_learning_boundary: Do not silently replace the second p_max with p_min. Keep source expression and mark any corrected construction as an independent extension, not source evidence.
warnings.source_basing: E01-E05 original local crop; corrected equation-group binding in local-visual-audit-v2.json. Same symbol subtraction is internal arithmetic, not external adjudication.
warnings.required_future_check: Substitute any distinct positive bounds in a future implementation and independently verify count/spacing before adopting this derivation.

warnings.precise_source_claim: continuous count to discrete action domain
warnings.warning: The logarithmic num_0 expression is not necessarily an integer, while the next formula uses indices through num+1 and Algorithm1 counts crossed grids. A rounding convention, positive-bound checks and degenerate-return handling are not supplied.
warnings.safe_learning_boundary: Retain logarithmic geometry as an explanatory mechanism, not ready-to-run discrete trading code. Domain and rounding are absent details rather than author-proved choices.
warnings.source_basing: E04 logarithmic relation, E05 index range, Algorithm1 min rule; source does not print floor/ceiling or a numerical feasibility branch.
warnings.required_future_check: Future use must declare r0/log domain, integer conversion and resulting feasibility; do not infer that any conversion preserves return constraints.

warnings.precise_source_claim: named model and implementation not completely connected
warnings.warning: Source application reports d=1, but the displayed ARIMA-named equation contains only a constant, lagged-price terms and lagged-error terms. The differencing/inverse-differencing mapping, coefficients, initialization and fitting implementation are not supplied.
warnings.safe_learning_boundary: Preserve the displayed expression and model name as source claims. Do not silently insert an unprinted operator or call the forecast numerically reproduced.
warnings.source_basing: Physical11 displayed equation; physical12 nearest30-day application with (p,q,d)=(6,9,1). Physical14 p=9,q=6 is a separately described next-period selection, not automatically a contradiction.
warnings.required_future_check: Any future implementation must bind data transform, fitted variable, inverse transform and forecast time to the formula actually executed.

warnings.precise_source_claim: undefined statistic index and reference distribution
warnings.warning: The displayed Q statistic sums over j but divides by n-i. Its ACF-tilde is defined on squared observations, while the prose introduces a residual-independence test; chi-square degrees of freedom and the exact tested series are not specified.
warnings.safe_learning_boundary: Do not replace this display by a remembered conventional test formula. No external statistical correction has been adopted; the record only establishes that this source does not uniquely determine a p-value calculation.
warnings.source_basing: Exact local crop E07-E09-ARIMA-diagnostics, audited formula E09. The free denominator index and missing distribution specification are source-internal findings.
warnings.required_future_check: For reuse require explicit lag index, tested series, normalization, reference distribution and implementation, then verify the downstream mu update against that result.

warnings.precise_source_claim: undefined rate at zero holdings and hindsight quantity
warnings.warning: PR_G and PR_B divide by preceding-period asset values, but no zero-holding branch is printed. PPR comes from all-known completed-period retesting, with no exact oracle procedure. A numeric ratio/parameter replay is underdetermined at those cases.
warnings.safe_learning_boundary: Do not manufacture a denominator epsilon, assign missing PPR, or move retrospective completed-period knowledge into live future decisions.
warnings.source_basing: Physical13 rate formulas and retrospective PPR bullet; physical17-18 allocation discussion. Zero holdings are a conditional boundary, not asserted as an observed zero in a particular unseen data row.
warnings.required_future_check: Specify nonzero-rate domain or explicit zero-state branch and freeze each information-availability time before reuse.

warnings.warning: Algorithm1 visibly repeats T_start at both ends of its input/output sequences, even though the accompanying prose says T_start to T_end. Printed step9 precedes step8. The operational loop termination is nevertheless explicitly t<=T_end.
warnings.safe_learning_boundary: Preserve source endpoints and printed numbering in transcription; explanatory pseudocode may state the intended time range only as a declared normalization. Do not treat formatting defects as the main paper contribution.
warnings.source_basing: A01-algorithm full proxy and independent audit. These are printed notation/sequence-label issues, not OCR guesses.

fact_notation_claim_warnings.source_basing: Physical5 Assumption1, physical7 Algorithm1; locally read official problem constraints in source-review.json.
